references.text: The priests carry the ark of the covenant before the people, as a preparation for what happens in verse 6.
The priests carrying the ark are instructed to stand still in the Jordan, continuing the command given in verse 6.
The people break camp from their encampments with the priests carrying the ark ahead of them, fulfilling the command in verse 6.
The priests who carried the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was completed, continuing their service from verse 6.
Joshua commands the priests to take up the ark of the covenant, a similar command as in chapter 3 verse 6.
The Levites carried the Lord's ark of the covenant, showing the priests' role in carrying the ark before the people.
The poles were to remain in the rings on the ark for carrying it, which the priests do in Joshua 3:6.
The book of Hebrews mentions the ark of the covenant and its contents, highlighting the significance of the ark that the priests carried.
